feature: Customer Portal v2 — Governance pillar area-card grid wired to REAL per-check scan data (Git #1333). Replaces the GOV_AREA_LINKS fixture's fabricated per-card scores/deltas/sparklines (#1330) with the tenant's real tenant_monitor_profiles counts for the ten confirmed-real Governance checks, read via GET /api/portal/governance/areas. The four cards with no backing check today — External Sharing Drift (a scan-to-scan drift check, blocked on #1287) and the three Devices cards — render an honest '—' no-data state instead of a fake number.
notes: THE API TEST IS THE REAL CONTRACT. SETUP+A1 exercise GET /api/portal/governance/areas and prove it returns one entry per confirmed-real card with a real value/prevValue/status; A1 extracts the App Governance card's live count, which the DOM step G1 then asserts is the number actually rendered on the card — an apiTests extract + uiStep textContains DOM-integration proof, not a captureResponse.

areas[] order is GOV_AREA_CHECK_DEFS order: oversharing(0), public-teams(1), channels(2), guests(3), group-owners(4), team-owners(5), orphaned-groups(6), orphaned-teams(7), app-access(8), pim(9). app-access maps to appgov:risky-permission-grants, which on the testbed tenant carries a real graded 'warning' severity and a non-zero count — the most robust real-value card to assert.

G2 is the HONEST no-data proof: External Sharing Drift has no backing check (pending #1287's drift engine), so its card value renders a literal '—', never a fabricated number. Same for the three Devices cards — deliberately not wired (no confirmed check).
The route is a direct tenant_monitor_profiles read (no war-room engine recompute), so it resolves fast — no >=90s element-wait needed, unlike the hero-score manifest.

ENV VARS required in BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables: DEPLOY_URL (the Portal origin, e.g. http://localhost:5175 — its /api proxies to the api-server), TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD, TEST_PORTAL_SLUG.

PRECONDITION: needs the api-server running WITH this issue's new /portal/governance/areas route (i.e. after the build-complete redeploy) — the route is registered in routes/index.ts. Until then the endpoint 404s and every card falls back to the honest '—' no-data state, so G1 (the real-value assertion) will not match while G2 still passes.

apiTests.name: SETUP -- log in as the TESTBED Assessment account; extract the bearer.
A1 -- GET the real area-card data. area[8] is App Governance (appgov:risky-permission-grants); extract its REAL live count, which the card renders.
A2 -- the App Governance card has real data (hasData true) — it is a wired card, not a no-data fallback.

uiSteps.name: G1 -- REAL: the App Governance card shows the live per-check count ({{appGovValue}}) from GET /portal/governance/areas, not a fixture number.
G2 -- HONEST NO-DATA: External Sharing Drift has no backing check (pending #1287), so the card renders a literal '—', never a fabricated score.
